legend: After the big birthday party, Katie still wanted Shiro to have some more fun. Later, she came up with a game called treasure hunt. Of course, she invited her best friends Kuro and Shiro to play with her.

The three friends are very smart so they passed all the challenges very quickly and finally reached the destination. But the treasure can only belong to one cat so they started to think of something which can determine who is worthy of the treasure. Instantly, Kuro came up with some ribbons.

A random colorful ribbon is given to each of the cats. Each color of the ribbon can be represented as an uppercase or lowercase Latin letter. Let's call a consecutive subsequence of colors that appears in the ribbon a subribbon. The beauty of a ribbon is defined as the maximum number of times one of its subribbon appears in the ribbon. The more the subribbon appears, the more beautiful is the ribbon. For example, the ribbon aaaaaaa has the beauty of 7$$$7$$$ because its subribbon a appears 7$$$7$$$ times, and the ribbon abcdabc has the beauty of 2$$$2$$$ because its subribbon abc appears twice.

The rules are simple. The game will have n$$$n$$$ turns. Every turn, each of the cats must change strictly one color (at one position) in his/her ribbon to an arbitrary color which is different from the unchanged one. For example, a ribbon aaab can be changed into acab in one turn. The one having the most beautiful ribbon after n$$$n$$$ turns wins the treasure.
Could you find out who is going to be the winner if they all play optimally?
input: The first line contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (0≤n≤109$$$0 \leq n \leq 10^{9}$$$) — the number of turns.

Next 3 lines contain 3 ribbons of Kuro, Shiro and Katie one per line, respectively. Each ribbon is a string which contains no more than 105$$$10^{5}$$$ uppercase and lowercase Latin letters and is not empty. It is guaranteed that the length of all ribbons are equal for the purpose of fairness. Note that uppercase and lowercase letters are considered different colors.
output: Print the name of the winner ("Kuro", "Shiro" or "Katie"). If there are at least two cats that share the maximum beauty, print "Draw".
note: In the first example, after 3$$$3$$$ turns, Kuro can change his ribbon into ooooo, which has the beauty of 5$$$5$$$, while reaching such beauty for Shiro and Katie is impossible (both Shiro and Katie can reach the beauty of at most 4$$$4$$$, for example by changing Shiro's ribbon into SSiSS and changing Katie's ribbon into Kaaaa). Therefore, the winner is Kuro.

In the fourth example, since the length of each of the string is 9$$$9$$$ and the number of turn is 15$$$15$$$, everyone can change their ribbons in some way to reach the maximal beauty of 9$$$9$$$ by changing their strings into zzzzzzzzz after 9 turns, and repeatedly change their strings into azzzzzzzz and then into zzzzzzzzz thrice. Therefore, the game ends in a draw.

legend.ai: 大型生日派对结束后，Katie 仍然想让 Shiro 再玩一会儿。后来，她想出了一个名为“寻宝”的游戏。当然，她邀请了自己最好的朋友 Kuro 和 Shiro 与她一起玩。
三位朋友都非常聪明，因此他们很快就通过了所有挑战，最终抵达了目的地。但是宝藏只能属于一只猫，于是他们开始思考如何确定谁配得上这份宝藏。Kuro 立刻想到了丝带。

一条随机的彩色缎带被送给每只猫。缎带的每一种颜色都可以用一个大写或小写拉丁字母表示。我们将缎带中出现的连续颜色子序列称为子缎带。缎带的美丽值定义为其某个子缎带在缎带中出现的最大次数。子缎带出现得越多，缎带就越美丽。例如，缎带 aaaaaaa 的美丽值为 7$$$7$$$，因为其子缎带 a 出现了 7$$$7$$$ 次；缎带 abcdabc 的美丽值为 2$$$2$$$，因为其子缎带 abc 出现了两次。
规则很简单。游戏将进行 n$$$n$$$ 轮。每一轮，每只猫都必须将自己缎带中恰好一个位置的颜色改成与该位置原来颜色不同的任意颜色。例如，缎带 aaab 在一轮中可以变成 acab。在 n$$$n$$$ 轮之后拥有最美丽缎带的猫将赢得宝藏。
如果它们都以最优策略游玩，你能找出谁会是赢家吗？

input.ai: 接下来 3 行分别包含 Kuro、Shiro 和 Katie 的 3 条缎带，每行一条。每条缎带是一个由不超过 105$$$10^{5}$$$ 个大写和小写拉丁字母组成的非空字符串。为了保证公平，保证所有缎带的长度相等。注意，大写字母和小写字母被视为不同的颜色。

output.ai: 输出赢家的名字（"Kuro"、"Shiro" 或 "Katie"）。如果至少有两只猫拥有相同的最大美丽值，输出 "Draw"。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，经过 3$$$3$$$ 回合后，Kuro 可以将他的彩带变成 ooooo，其美丽度为 5$$$5$$$，而 Shiro 和 Katie 无法达到这样的美丽度(两者最多只能达到 4$$$4$$$，例如可以将 Shiro 的彩带变成 SSiSS，将 Katie 的彩带变成 Kaaaa)。因此，获胜者是 Kuro。
在第四个样例中，由于每个字符串的长度都是 9$$$9$$$，而回合数为 15$$$15$$$，所以每个人都能以某种方式改变自己的彩带，达到最大美丽度 9$$$9$$$：经过 9 个回合将字符串变成 zzzzzzzzz，然后反复将字符串变成 azzzzzzzz 再变回 zzzzzzzzz，共重复三次。因此，游戏以平局告终。
